description: Ask ChatGPT to generate an image and download it to disk

steps.description: Temporary Chat: drafts run many times a day and would otherwise fill Jon's ChatGPT history. Nothing here is worth keeping.
steps._note: Defaults to https://chatgpt.com/ which starts a NEW conversation every run -- that is how fifteen junk threads appeared in Jon's sidebar on 2026-08-25. x-image-gen.py passes the previous conversation URL here so runs share one thread.

Step ceiling must stay BELOW the caller's subprocess ceiling, or the run is killed before it can report and every failure looks identical. It was 920s against a 620s caller, which is how six debugging runs produced no information at all.
wait_for_image returns as soon as the element appears, which is before it has decoded and painted. The canvas grab then found naturalWidth 0 and reported 'no image found on the page'.

Click ChatGPT's own download control. The canvas approach and download_images both failed; the UI has a save button and using it is what a person does. Returns every nearby control label too, so the selector can be repaired without another generation if the UI shifts.
steps.text: (function(){var labels=[];var all=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('button,a,[role="button"],[role="menuitem"]'));all.forEach(function(x){var l=(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||x.title||x.textContent||'').trim();if(l&&l.length<60)labels.push(l);});var dl=all.filter(function(x){var l=((x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')+' '+(x.title||'')+' '+(x.textContent||'')).toLowerCase();return /download|save image|save picture/.test(l);});if(dl.length){dl[dl.length-1].click();return JSON.stringify({ok:true,clicked:(dl[dl.length-1].getAttribute('aria-label')||dl[dl.length-1].textContent||'').trim().slice(0,60),labels:labels.slice(-40)});}return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'no download control found',labels:labels.slice(-40)});})()

steps._note: ChatGPT rewrites the URL to /c/<id> once the first message is sent. Returned so the caller can store it.
